title: Identify Reaction Type
text: Delta H = -92 kJ means the forward reaction releases heat (exothermic). The reverse reaction absorbs heat (endothermic).

title: Effect of Temperature Increase
text: Increasing temperature adds heat energy. The system will shift to use up this extra heat.

title: Determine Shift Direction
text: The system favors the endothermic direction (reverse) to absorb heat. Equilibrium shifts LEFT towards reactants.
